summary: Six-phase implementation plan written for the marker/session correlation defect. Adds cc_session_id to the .postflight-pending writer, correlates both hooks' marker selection (subagent-postflight.sh and events-log-lifecycle.sh) with a binding no-match-means-no-action fail-safe, labels cap-reached deletion distinctly, extends the existing fixture test with cross-session cases, and syncs postflight-control.md.
